goal.text: Keep a running account of where each load of folded clothing has been carried, so the user can tell what is still sitting on the sofa before finishing.

turns.text: I want all this through to the bedroom. What have I done?

trigger.detail: first garment lifted off the sofa and opened out, folding begins

expected_answer.text: So far you've stacked the bags of clothing on the sofa with your right hand, then lifted one garment off it, opened it out, and begun folding.

trigger.detail: user cuts in over the status summary to pin down a detail

expected_answer.text: Your left. You picked it up left-handed, then brought both hands in to spread it open.

turns.text: So that one's done — where did it end up?

trigger.detail: folded garment set down and a fresh one picked up

expected_answer.text: On the backrest of the sofa. You leaned over and laid it there with your right hand before going back for another.

turns.text: mm-hm — mm, sorry, and the next one? Did that go to the same place?

trigger.detail: second garment set down during the backchannel

expected_answer.text: No — that one went onto the armrest instead, not the backrest.

turns.text: Those bags — did the floor one reach the seat?

trigger.detail: bag transferred from the floor up onto the sofa

expected_answer.text: Yes, you did — you bent down, moved it up off the floor, and set it on the cushion with your right hand.

turns.text: wait — there was a clear ziplock one in with it, where'd that go?

trigger.detail: user interrupts the confirmation to chase a second container

expected_answer.text: The resealable one? You put it down on the sofa and picked the sweater up with both hands.

turns.text: What was the last thing I folded before lifting it?

trigger.detail: a quiet stretch while walking toward the bedroom

expected_answer.text: The sweater. You folded it for about thirteen seconds, laid it on top of the stack, then gathered the whole lot up.

turns.text: — and it's going down on what in here, the bed?

trigger.detail: user talks over the answer as the bedroom comes into view

expected_answer.text: Not the bed — the chair. You bent over and set the stack down on it, then straightened up to talk.

trigger.detail: second armful set down in the bedroom

expected_answer.text: That one you took back out and laid on the lower bunk, not on the chair where the first lot went.

turns.text: hold on — did I take the ziplock through with that, or is it still out there?

trigger.detail: user cuts in worrying about a container left behind

expected_answer.text: Still out there — it's sat on the sofa since you set it down, and you're only now putting it onto the pile.

turns.text: Right — so what's riding on top of it now?

trigger.detail: loose bags dropped onto the folded stack

expected_answer.text: A couple of plastic bags. You pulled them off the sofa with your right hand and dropped them on the folded clothes.

turns.text: — that's the third trip then, right?

trigger.detail: user cuts in to total up the trips as they set off again

expected_answer.text: Third one, yes — chair first, then the lower bunk, and this load is on its way to the bed.

turns.text: And this one — down where, exactly?

trigger.detail: third armful released in the bedroom

expected_answer.text: Onto the bed itself this time. You leaned in, shifted it across with both hands, and left it there.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — is the sofa actually clear now, or have I left stuff on it?

trigger.detail: user interrupts on the way back to check what remains

expected_answer.text: Not clear yet — there's still a loose pile on the cushions, and you're reaching for it right now.

turns.text: Okay — back to the tally. Where does that leave me overall?

trigger.detail: a lull midway through the next round of folding

expected_answer.text: Three loads delivered — chair, bunk, bed — and one batch still here on the sofa that you're working through.

turns.text: Right, I'll finish these and bring them in one go. Just tell me if I miss any.

trigger.detail: user closes out with an instruction

expected_answer.text: Will do — I'll flag anything left on the cushions when you head off.
